name: std::wcscmp
intro:
Compares two null-terminated wide strings lexicographically.

The sign of the result is the sign of the difference between the values of the first pair of wide characters that differ in the strings being compared.

The behavior is undefined if lhs or rhs are not pointers to null-terminated wide strings.

sections.title: Parameters
sections.text:
lhs, rhs

 -

 pointers to the null-terminated wide strings to compare

sections.title: Return value
sections.text:
Negative value if lhs appears before rhs in lexicographical order.

Zero if lhs and rhs compare equal.

Positive value if lhs appears after rhs in lexicographical order.

sections.title: Notes
sections.text: This function is not locale-sensitive, unlike std::wcscoll, and the order may not be meaningful when characters from different Unicode blocks are used together or when the order of code units does not match collation order.

examples.output: А Б Г Л М С Х Ч

summary: Compares two null-terminated wide strings lexicographically.
